texts.IniHeader:
MapForGoblins configuration. Auto-generated from the in-code schema;
the DLL re-syncs this file on launch (adds new keys, comments out removed ones).
texts.RandomizerHint: Using a Randomizer? Enable live_loot_flags + live_loot_labels + live_loot_icons so markers match the shuffled item placements.
texts.FastMapOpenWarning: BETA: makes the map open faster. If the map glitches or crashes, turn this off.
texts.ReopenMapWarning: You MUST re-open the world map to see changes!
texts.DebugDumpDescription: Dumps the map beacons (your 1-5 placed markers) and stamps to text. Works whether the map is open or closed. Press Copy to put it on the clipboard.
texts.NoDumpYet: (no dump yet - press the button above)
texts.InjectStatusHint: If icons are missing, screenshot or copy this for a bug report.
texts.AboutDescription: Thousands of loot and world icons on the in-game map.
texts.ControlHintGamepad: D-Pad/Stick: move   A: toggle   B: close   LB/RB: switch tab
texts.ControlHintKeyboard: Mouse + Arrows: move   Click/Space: toggle   Esc: close
texts.MasterToggleTooltip:
Turns ALL map icons on/off at once.
When the overlay is disabled, toggle_key / the gamepad combo do this from outside the menu.
texts.ProgressHint: Collected vs total per region. Hidden categories are excluded; some hard-to-track pickups may lag.
texts.ProgressClickHint: Click a category to show ONLY its uncollected markers on the map (click again to clear).

section_comments.Reforged: Elden Ring Reforged-only content. Absent from the vanilla build.
section_comments.ERR Markers:
This section applies this mod's display rules to ERR's OWN pre-placed map
markers (camps, merchants, bosses, dungeon entrances) - NOT the icons this
mod injects - so both icon sets follow the same visibility logic
(map-fragment discovery, hide on clear). Disable a toggle to leave that
marker group exactly as ERR ships it. Our own boss markers are
[World] show_bosses and independent of this section.
section_comments.Compatibility: Options for running alongside other mods that change item placement.
section_comments.Overlay & Hotkeys:
The in-game config overlay and the key/button that opens it. toggle_key
(keyboard) / toggle_gamepad_combo (gamepad) OPEN the overlay when enable_overlay
is on, or toggle ALL map icons on/off when it's off. Key names: F1-F24, A-Z,
0-9, Space, Escape, Tab, Enter, Backspace, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Insert,
Delete, arrows.
section_comments.Debug: Diagnostics, shown on the overlay's Debug tab.

entry_comments.require_map_fragments: Require map fragment discovery before showing icons in that area
entry_comments.fast_map_open:
BETA: makes the world map open faster when many icons are shown.
Turn off if the map glitches or crashes.
entry_comments.show_celestial_dew: Celestial Dew (for reversing Spirit Ashes upgrades)
entry_comments.show_crystal_tears: Crystal Tears (for Flask of Wondrous Physick)
entry_comments.show_pots_n_perfumes: Cracked Pots, Ritual Pots, Perfume Bottles
entry_comments.show_seeds_tears: Golden Seeds, Sacred Tears, Revered Spirit Ashes
entry_comments.show_merchant_bell_bearings:
Bell Bearings dropped by killing merchants (Kale, Patches, Gostoc,
nomadic merchants, etc.)
entry_comments.show_utilities: Utility items (rainbow stone, glowstone, soap, soft cotton)
entry_comments.show_stat_boosts: Stat-up items (Starlight Shards, Sacrificial Twig, Blessing of Marika)
entry_comments.show_material_nodes: One-time gathering nodes (Erdleaf Flower, Trina's Lily, etc.)
entry_comments.show_reusables: Reusable tools (Mimic Veil, Margit's Shackle, etc.)
entry_comments.show_throwables: Throwable items (darts, daggers, stones, chakrams, warming stones)
entry_comments.show_rune_arcs: Rune Arcs (buffs for active Great Rune)
entry_comments.show_prayerbooks: Prayerbooks and Scrolls (unlock spells at vendors)
entry_comments.show_progression: Quest progression items (medallions, keys, Needles, quest-specific goods)
entry_comments.show_seedbed_curses: Seedbed Curse locations (for Dung Eater quest)
entry_comments.show_items_and_changes: ERR-added items: Oracle Effigy/Remedy, Starlight Tokens, Sealed Curios
entry_comments.show_imp_statues: Imp Statue (Stonesword Key fog gate) locations
entry_comments.show_kindling_spirits:
ERR Kindling Spirits in Misty Forest - collect all 5 between rests for
the Kindling Spirit incantation. Markers hide once you have the incantation.
entry_comments.show_interactables:
Interactive world objects & puzzles: blue seal puzzles (unlock hidden
cellars), light-flame interacts (Sellia chalices, Snow Town statues, Siofra
River lanterns), and Hero's Tomb direction statues.
entry_comments.hide_killed_bosses: Hide boss/invader/hawk markers after defeat (false = show green checkmark instead)
entry_comments.patch_overworld_boss_icons:
Apply this mod's map-fragment discovery rule to ERR's overworld
field-boss markers.
entry_comments.patch_dungeon_boss_icons:
Apply this mod's map-fragment discovery rule to ERR's dungeon/cave
entrance markers. Required for hide_dungeon_icons_on_clear below.
entry_comments.patch_camp_icons: Apply this mod's map-fragment discovery rule to ERR's enemy camp markers.
entry_comments.patch_merchant_icons: Apply this mod's map-fragment discovery rule to ERR's merchant markers.
entry_comments.hide_dungeon_icons_on_clear:
When patching dungeon entrances, hide the marker once the boss inside is
defeated. Requires patch_dungeon_boss_icons.
entry_comments.live_loot_flags:
Hide loot markers using the pickup flag from the loaded regulation, so they
disappear correctly under the Item/Enemy Randomizer or other regulation mods.
entry_comments.live_loot_labels:
Relabel each loot marker with the item its lot currently gives, so names match
the randomizer. Uses more memory (copies item names into the map's name table).
entry_comments.live_loot_icons:
Give each loot marker the icon and category of the item its lot currently
gives, so icons and show_* toggles match the randomizer.
entry_comments.anonymous_loot:
Spoiler-free: every loot marker shows a gray "?" and a generic label instead
of the real item. Overrides live_loot_labels/icons; markers still hide on pickup.
entry_comments.ui_language:
Overlay language. auto follows the Steam game language; unrecognized languages
fall back to English.
entry_comments.enable_overlay:
In-game config overlay (Dear ImGui) opened with the toggle key below.
Set false if a DX-hook conflict (Steam overlay/RTSS/GeForce Experience) or a
GPU driver issue makes the game unstable.
entry_comments.enable_toggle_hotkey:
Enable toggle_key / toggle_gamepad_combo to switch ALL map icons on/off when
the overlay is DISABLED. (When the overlay is enabled, they open it instead.)
entry_comments.toggle_key:
Keyboard toggle: OPENS the config overlay when enable_overlay is on, or
toggles ALL map icons on/off when the overlay is disabled. Default: F10.
entry_comments.toggle_gamepad_combo:
Gamepad toggle, same role as toggle_key (opens the overlay, or toggles all
icons if the overlay is disabled). Tokens joined with '+': A,B,X,Y,LB,RB,
L3/LSTICK,R3/RSTICK,BACK/SELECT/VIEW,START/MENU,UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT. Default: Y+R3.
entry_comments.debug_logging: Enable verbose debug logging (memory addresses, param details, FMG internals)
entry_comments.enable_marker_dump: Master switch for the marker dump hotkey
entry_comments.marker_dump_key: Key to dump decoded markers to logs/MapForGoblins_markers.log. Default: F9.
